bandReport.notes: 34 questions, contiguous 1-34, no gaps and no duplicates. Per-page split: p01 Q1-Q7 (printed 3-A), p02 Q8-Q15 (5-A), p03 Q16-Q20 (7-A), p04 Q21-Q27 (9-A), p05 Q28-Q34 (11-A). p01 opens cleanly at Q1 (p00 is the cover/instructions leaf and carries no questions). BAND EDGE: p05 ends complete at Q34 — its option (d) ('...National Coal Development Corporation Ltd.') was crop-verified at 8x, the two-column vertical rule stops below it, the remaining bottom fifth of the leaf is blank, and then the footer '( 11 - A )' prints. Nothing continues overleaf, so B2 must open at Q35. CODE-OPTION ORDERS WERE ALL READ OFF THE PAGE, AND THIS BAND ALONE CARRIES THREE DIFFERENT LAYOUTS: Q7 runs 1 only / 1 and 2 only / 2 and 3 only / 1, 2 and 3 (all-three row at (d)); Q8 runs 1 only / 1 and 2 only / 2 only / 1 and 3 only (NO all-three row at all, and '2 only' sits at (c) rather than the (b) position it usually occupies); Q25 runs 1 only / 1 and 3 only / 2 and 3 only / 3 only (again no all-three row, ending on a single-statement row). Each was crop-verified at 8x. No option letter may be inferred from another question in this booklet. PAPER-LEVEL NOTE from the cover (p00): Test Booklet Series A, T.B.C. NYRG-B-GNL, GENERAL KNOWLEDGE, Two Hours, Maximum Marks 100, 120 items printed in both Hindi and English, one-third negative marking. No Match Lists, no figures, graphs, diagrams or circuits anywhere in this band. No 'P.T.O.' marking on any page of this band. Devanagari show-through from the Hindi printed on the reverse of each leaf is present throughout but faint, sits between the English lines, and obscured no English glyph; it was ignored as show-through, not content.
